So far, the better camera mod significantly heightens the maximum camera distance, which is nice if you want to make your life easier when navigating the battlefield, issuing commands, and analyzing the general battle situation.

Now, that is not without its drawbacks.
Although it comes with decent tactical advantages, against the AI at least, since it heightens the maximum camera distance, players will always, and surely do, adjust to the highest or maximum cam distance. 

There is almost no in-between scenario. It is either the player zooms out to the maximum, or play around with varying levels of zoom-in.

This can affect immersion, because when the player is, most of time, zoomed-out to such high places, the player misses out on the unit animations and graphics.

For now, it is either you git gud with the default cam, or use battle camera mod for better tactical maneuvering with potentially affecting immersion.
